description: This file contains helper functions for interacting with the Federal Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) API, including retrieving timeseries data, survey assets, static series ID and code map assets, and updating static assets. It also defines functions to make requests, process data, and handle static files relevant to BLS data integration within the larger project.

methods.name: Dict get_bls_timeseries( api_key: str, series_ids: Union[str, List[str]], start_year: Optional[int] = None, end_year: Optional[int] = None, calculations: bool = True, catalog: bool = True, annual_average: bool = True, aspects: bool = False, )
methods.description: Fetches BLS timeseries data with parameters controlling the range, symbols, and details included. Handles data conversion, date formatting based on period types, and error handling for no data scenarios.

methods.name: "DataFrame" get_survey_asset(survey: str, asset: str)
methods.description: Retrieves survey asset files from BLS FTP, loads them into a pandas DataFrame, cleans, and returns it.

methods.name: Tuple[List,Dict] download_category_series_ids(category)
methods.description: Downloads all series IDs for a specific survey category, along with code maps for static data updates.

methods.name: Union["DataFrame",Dict] open_asset(asset: str)
methods.description: Opens static asset files (.json or .xz) for series IDs or code maps, for static data management.

methods.name: None update_static_asset(category: str)
methods.description: Updates static asset files with latest series IDs and code maps for a given category, saving them as CSV and JSON.
